title: FlexHook resume-state patch and real smoke-run verification
scope: isolated FlexHook checkout launched by this research workspace

resume_compatibility.sampler_policy: DistributedSampler.set_epoch(epoch) remains deterministic from the registered seed; worker-local state is not separately serialized

flexhook_f1_internal_core_seed42.claim_boundary: Its checkpoints remain evaluation artifacts; this already-running job is not claimed as a patched resume run.

flexhook_resume_smoke_seed42.purpose: Produced a patched checkpoint containing optimizer, scheduler, scaler, epoch and RNG state for the recovery test.

flexhook_resume_smoke_seed42_resumed_v2.purpose: Loaded the smoke checkpoint and completed epoch 2 on one GPU.

flexhook_resume_smoke_seed42_resumed.claim_boundary: The source checkpoint loaded at epoch 1 before the legacy internal-validation tuple mismatch stopped the attempt; this is retained as an attempt record, not a resume failure.

future_flexhook_runs.claim_boundary: The launcher fails closed if either tracked patch cannot be applied or verified.

verification.result: 3 targeted tests passed; full project suite passes

real_training_checkpoint_resume.postprocess_bypass: FGREFMOT_SKIP_FLEXHOOK_POSTPROCESS=1 was used only for this smoke recovery because the pinned legacy postprocess expects an incompatible validation tuple/seqmap path.

legacy_postprocess_compatibility_attempt: The first resumed attempt loaded epoch 1, then failed because legacy inference expected 10 values but received 6.
A subsequent legacy postprocess path reached a seqmap list/string TypeError; the opt-in smoke bypass allowed training and checkpoint save to proceed.

claim_boundary: A real patched one-GPU checkpoint resume is verified: the source loaded at epoch 1, training continued at epoch 2, validation and checkpoint save completed, and the wrapper exited 0. The smoke F1 is a recovery-sanity observation, not a final baseline or improvement claim. Multi-GPU recovery and resuming the already-running strict core job remain unverified.
